title: DECISION: Accept self-signed TLS certs from tailnet peers with explicit safety rationale
description: TailnetCertVerifier accepts any cert from a tailnet peer because Tailscale provides cryptographic identity at the network layer (WireGuard). TLS cert is only for confidentiality, not authentication. Design choice is documented clearly (peer_fetch.rs:215-221) so not a hidden security assumption. Prevents the complexity of PKI/CA management for internal peer-to-peer calls.
